questions.questionText: “Due to heavy rain, the game is postponed.” Due to means…
The concert has been ______ to next month. (adiado)

explanations.general: The concert has been postponed to next month.

questions.questionText: ______ of Monday, the library opens at 7. (a partir de)

explanations.general: As of Monday, the library opens at 7.

questions.questionText: “Students are required to bring an ID.” This means…

options.text: Bringing an ID is a good idea.

explanations.general: Correct answer: Bringing an ID is mandatory.

questions.questionText: The ______ for the event is the main auditorium. (local do evento)

explanations.general: The venue for the event is the main auditorium.

content.text: O formato de quase todo anúncio
Please… / You are required to… / Make sure…

Due to a water pipe repair, there will be no hot water on Tuesday from 8 a.m. to 2 p.m. Residents who need to shower are encouraged to use the facilities in the Recreation Center, which will open one hour earlier, at 6 a.m. We apologize for the inconvenience.

content.text: . O aluno preenche a grade de 4 enquanto ouve. Depois relata oralmente em 45 segundos.

Attention, students. This year's Career Fair, originally scheduled for Wednesday, November 14, in the Student Center, has been moved to Thursday, November 15, and will take place in the Sports Arena. The change is due to the large number of companies — more than 80 have registered. The fair runs from 10 a.m. to 4 p.m. Students are encouraged to bring several copies of their résumé, and those who want a professional photo for their LinkedIn profile can get one for free at the entrance. A free shuttle will run from the library every 15 minutes.

Good afternoon. This is a message from the IT department. As of next Monday, all students will be required to use two-step verification to access their university email. To set it up, download the authentication app and follow the instructions on the IT website. Students who have not completed the setup by Sunday at midnight will be temporarily locked out of their accounts. If you need help, the IT Help Desk on the second floor of the library will be open extended hours this week, until 9 p.m.
